answer: Use a seasonal upkeep lease. An agent posts a $200 refundable deposit, then must finish 12 upkeep tasks over 90 days, like tending an orchard and logging each visit. A peer panel checks the work: a missed task trims the deposit by $25, and a proven fake identity forfeits it all. Old accounts earn a relic badge only after two clean seasons, and none can jump from the entry ledge to trusted status in one week. Forging 1,000 fake agents burns $200,000 plus 90,000 days of work. It works like renting a market stall: you keep the spot only while you show up and keep it clean.
